tasks.short: Monitor hotel revenue activity and read exceptions.

steps.what: Post the hotel revenue activity total on schedule.
Read revenue activity exceptions the total flagged.
Decide which hotel revenue exception needs action.
File the approved revenue exception note.

tasks.design: The hotel revenue activity total already runs in {OPS_SYSTEM} and shows on {BI}. The lodging manager reads the exceptions and decides which need action. {BI} files that decision. The scheduled total is not human time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Someone copied the day's revenue into a sheet so it could be watched.
tasks.enabler_now: The property system already posts the total. The human work that remains is reading exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: An exception still needs a person who knows whether the figure is a group booking, a correction or a problem.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides what an exception means. The total does not.

ambition.what: a revenue exception on the day the total flags it

tasks.altitude: The manager stops assembling the total and still decides which exceptions matter. The scheduled total was never the manager's time.

reach.learn: Start from the exception the lodging manager marked, not from a fresh export

evidence.claim: A property system that already posts revenue does not create a new human saving when that post is left in place.

assumptions: The scheduled revenue activity total is existing system work. It is excluded from the focal baseline. The saving is only a shorter read of exceptions, not the total itself.
The task is labelled automate. The steps disagree with counting the total as saved human labour. The person still decides on each exception.
An exception note stores the date, the figure, the reason the manager wrote, and the decision. The manager produces the decision. No forecast is generated.
The workflow ends when the exception note is filed. It does not change a rate.
unknowns: Whether anyone still builds this total by hand.
Which variance size the manager wants flagged before they will look.
research_questions: Is the revenue activity total already a scheduled post in the property system?

already_counted.description: Reading flagged exceptions is already in the review step

incremental.description: Keep the exception thresholds the manager set

approvals.approved_version: revenue exception note the lodging manager decided after reading the total

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The scheduled total is system time and is not saved human labour. The manager still reads and decides. 44 percent is work the system already does and is not saved human labour. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain temporary and permanent lodging facilities.

steps.what: Walk temporary and permanent lodging facilities.
Decide which lodging defect to maintain first.
Review the maintain request from the lodging walk.

loop.input: The walk notes and the priority the lodging manager set after the walk
loop.output: A maintain request that names only defects written in the walk notes
loop.check: The lodging manager rejects any defect that was not in the walk notes
loop.stop: One draft. Unread defects stay out. No second pass.
loop.why_not_simpler: Walk notes are free text, so a fixed request form cannot start from what was seen

steps.what: Send the approved lodging maintain request.
Check repaired lodging facilities on a later walk.

tasks.design: The lodging manager walks the facilities and decides the priority. A draft request uses only those walk notes, and the manager checks it before {WORKFLOW} sends it to maintenance. A later walk checks the repair. The first walk is the evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Defects were phoned through or written on a pad after the walk, then typed again.
tasks.enabler_now: A request can be sent once the manager has accepted the wording of what they already saw.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the defect, and checking the repair, still require the person on site.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees the facility and sets the priority. The request cannot invent a defect.
tasks.altitude: Walking the facilities and checking repairs stay in the week. Typing the request after the walk gets shorter.

reach.task: Carry out a repair from a work request
reach.learn: Treat the request as the manager's accepted note from the walk, not as a new inspection

evidence.claim: A work request can repeat notes a person wrote after a site walk, once that person has accepted the wording.

assumptions: The request stores the place, the defect in the manager's words, and the priority set after the walk. The manager produces the priority. Nothing is inferred from a camera.
The approval is the review after the walk, not the later check. The later walk does not feed the request.
The prior classes this as human. The steps agree. The walk and the repair check stay at full time.
Upkeep is the place names on the request.
unknowns: Whether maintenance already receives defects from another system.
Which facilities are temporary and which are permanent at this site.
research_questions: Who receives a maintain request today, and in what form?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the request against the walk notes is already in that step

incremental.description: Keep place names on the maintain request

approvals.approved_version: maintain request the lodging manager accepted after the facility walk

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The walks stay at full time. Only drafting the request from notes already taken is shorter. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Decide which staff members to train.
Train the staff members in person.
Record attendance after you train staff members.

tasks.design: Training stays in the room with the lodging manager. {LMS} can hold the attendance the manager enters after the session. No course is generated and no one is scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: Attendance was a separate sheet from the session.
tasks.enabler_now: A learning record can store attendance without generating the training.
tasks.still_hard: Showing someone how to do the work still takes the manager's time.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides who needs training and delivers it. A record of attendance is not the training.
tasks.altitude: The training sessions stay. Writing attendance afterwards is a little shorter. No course is produced for the manager.

reach.task: Show a new desk clerk the arrival steps
reach.learn: Keep the demonstration in person and record only attendance

evidence.claim: Recording attendance is a register. It does not deliver the training.
Deciding who must be trained is a staff decision and stays with the manager.

assumptions: The attendance record stores the session, the names the manager marked and the date. The manager produces the list of who attends. No score is stored.
The prior classes this as human. The steps agree. The session stays at full time.
National rules may require a works-council check before training records that rank staff are kept. This design stores attendance only.
Upkeep is the session names in the learning record. No generated material needs a review cycle because none is generated.
unknowns: Whether a works council must consent before attendance is stored.
Whether training is already recorded by a trainer who is not the lodging manager.
research_questions: What does the manager record today after a training session?

already_counted.description: Deciding who attends is already in the opening step

incremental.description: Keep session names in the learning record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The training itself remains. Attendance entry is only slightly shorter. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe staff against facility policies and procedures.

steps.what: Compare what you observe with facility policies.
Decide coaching from what you observe of staff.
Note the coaching decision against facility procedures.

tasks.design: The lodging manager watches the shift and compares it with the written procedures. Any coaching is the manager's decision, spoken to the person. The note, if kept, is the manager's own words. There is no score and no model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Observation was already the manager walking the floor. Little of it was a system problem.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new makes watching a person faster.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the work, and deciding whether to coach, stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager watches and coaches. A score would be a different and unacceptable task.
tasks.altitude: Nothing material changes in the week. The manager still observes staff and still decides any coaching. No performance score is introduced.

reach.task: Correct a desk procedure during a shift
reach.learn: Coach from what you saw, and do not attach a score

evidence.claim: Watching staff at work is not a record that can be generated.
Evaluating staff, including any score of behaviour or traits, is a decision that stays with a person under EU rules on automated decisions.

assumptions: No model watches staff, ranks them, or drafts the coaching. The note is typed by the manager or not kept.
The prior classes this as human. The steps agree, including the large share of time on the floor.
Rostering or scoring on behaviour would raise high-risk and works-council questions. This task does not do that.
Upkeep is zero beyond the procedures the hotel already maintains, because no new register is added. The small allowance is a review of whether notes are being stored at all.
unknowns: Whether any performance note is stored today, and whether a works council must consent first.
Whether 'monitor' here means a camera or a loss-prevention tool. If it does, that tool is out of scope and needs its own consent.
research_questions: Are observation notes stored, and who can read them?

already_counted.description: Watching the shift is already the whole of the opening step

incremental.description: Review whether coaching notes are stored at all

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Observation, comparison and coaching remain almost entirely with the manager. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The revenue total is no longer assembled by hand, and the manager still decides the exceptions. Walks, training and watching the floor stay as they are.
reach: Maintenance uses the request the manager accepted after the walk
A trainer's attendance list is not a substitute for the session
skills_to_grow: Reading a revenue exception without treating the total as a decision
Writing a maintain request only from the walk just done
Coaching from what was seen, without a score
role.ambitious_version: Exceptions are decided on the day the total flags them, and a maintain request names only what the walk found.
